title: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(6)
desc: 非洲的大型野生动物该被猎杀吗?(6)

paragraphs.en: Conservation in such circumstances is logistically challenging and extremely expensive.
paragraphs.zh: 在这样的环境下开展野生动物保护工作，后勤难度大且成本极高。

paragraphs.en: It has sucked up years of Littleton's life and millions of dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 这件事耗费了利特尔顿数年光阴与数百万美元资金。

paragraphs.en: Without income from trophy hunters, he says, it would be unworkable.
paragraphs.zh: 他表示，如果没有战利品猎人带来的收入，这项保护工作根本难以为继。

paragraphs.en: He comes to the matter with a raw pragmatism.
paragraphs.zh: 看待这件事，他秉持着一种直白务实的态度。

paragraphs.en: The most vociferous anti-hunting lobbyists will never get to what he calls "the dirty end" of conservation, where killing something can apparently save it.
paragraphs.zh: 那些呼声最高的反狩猎游说人士永远不会触及他口中保护工作“不堪的现实一面”，也就是通过猎杀部分动物，反倒有可能拯救整个物种。

paragraphs.en: He can't claim his hunting clients share his nuanced views on conservation and rural development.
paragraphs.zh: 他并不奢求前来狩猎的客户能够和他一样，对生态保护与乡村发展有着细致周全的见解。

paragraphs.en: But, ultimately, does it matter if they pay their bill in a timely fashion?
paragraphs.zh: 但说到底，只要他们按时付清费用，看法不同又有什么关系呢？

paragraphs.en: Ethical dilemmas are nothing new to conservation, a field in which the interests of one species may often be weighed against those of another.
paragraphs.zh: 伦理困境对于生态保护领域早已不是新鲜事，这一领域常常需要权衡不同物种之间的利益取舍。

paragraphs.en: But the trade-off is made explicit in the case of trophy hunting.
paragraphs.zh: 而战利品狩猎则把这种利弊权衡赤裸裸地摆在了台面上。

paragraphs.en: Fifteen African countries, including Tanzania, Namibia and South Africa, rely on trophy hunting to fund, wholly or in part, their conservation efforts.
paragraphs.zh: 包括坦桑尼亚、纳米比亚、南非在内的15个非洲国家，全部或部分依靠战利品狩猎，为野生动物保护项目提供资金。

paragraphs.en: Zambia, where 23% of all land is tied up in privately managed reserves, banned the practice in 2013, only to reverse the decision in 2014 owing to lack of alternative funding.
paragraphs.zh: 赞比亚有23%的土地划归私人保护区管理，该国曾于2013年禁止战利品狩猎，却因找不到替代资金来源，在2014年又撤销了这项禁令。

paragraphs.en: Still, those who rail against the killing of wild animals for sport protest that this system only serves to maintain a reliance on, and subservience to, a foreign, usually white, elite.
paragraphs.zh: 即便如此，强烈反对出于消遣猎杀野生动物的人士提出抗议，称这套制度只会让当地继续依附外来精英群体，而这类精英大多是白人。

paragraphs.en: Others begrudge the excess concern paid by foreigners to protected animals – as embodied by the international outcry over the death of Cecil the lion in Zimbabwe in 2015 – in contrast to a dearth of concern for Black African people living in poverty.
paragraphs.zh: 还有一部分人不满外国人过度关注受保护动物，典型事例便是2015年津巴布韦狮子塞西尔被杀一事引发的国际舆论哗然；与之形成鲜明对比的是，身处贫困之中的非洲黑人却很少得到外界的关切。

paragraphs.en: Any current model that positions rural communities as a danger to the environment they live in risks alienating those populations from their homelands and severing traditional moral and religious connections they have with native landscapes.
paragraphs.zh: 倘若现行模式始终将当地乡村居民视作其所居土地环境的威胁，就有可能造成本土民众与故土渐行渐远，斩断他们与这片土地之间传承已久的道德纽带和精神联结。

paragraphs.en: For these pre-colonial philosophies served the environment well; centuries of subsistence hunters coexisted with vast populations of wild animals.
paragraphs.zh: 殖民时代以前形成的生存理念曾经很好地守护了环境；数百年来，自给狩猎的原住民与数量庞大的野生动物和谐共存。

paragraphs.en: (The last great springbok migration, estimated to have numbered 260 million animals, took place in 1896 – only a decade after the Berlin Conference formalised the colonial carve-up of an entire continent.)
paragraphs.zh: （史上最后一次大规模跳羚迁徙发生在1896年，据估算迁徙动物多达2.6亿只；而这距离柏林会议正式瓜分整个非洲大陆，仅仅过去了十年。）

paragraphs.en: The trophy hunting system surely cannot survive in its current form.
paragraphs.zh: 战利品狩猎这套体系，以如今的形式定然无法长久存续。

paragraphs.en: It is too contentious, too racially divisive.
paragraphs.zh: 它争议重重，还极易造成种族对立。

paragraphs.en: African conservation more generally, shaped by outside influence and funding, also echoes with old, colonial attitudes.
paragraphs.zh: 放眼整个非洲的生态保护事业，由于长期受外部力量与外来资金影响，依旧残留着旧时殖民思维的影子。

paragraphs.en: Some African thinkers – such as the development expert Danford Chibvongodze – have called for a new approach altogether, perhaps underpinned by the more culturally appropriate values of Ubuntu, a southern African philosophy of interconnectedness that may be incompatible with the notion of the "wilderness" reserve.
paragraphs.zh: 部分非洲思想家，例如发展问题专家丹福德·奇布翁戈泽，呼吁彻底开辟一条全新道路，或许可以以南非“乌班图”理念作为价值根基。这一本土哲学倡导万物休戚与共，而它和“荒野保护区”的理念或许本身就难以兼容。

paragraphs.en: In the meantime, perhaps the most confounding thing of all is that – in Niassa at least – the current approach seems to be working.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，最令人费解的一点或许在于，至少在尼亚萨保护区，现行模式目前看起来行之有效。

paragraphs.en: The lion population in the special reserve, now estimated at anywhere from 800 to 1,200, is one of the few populations in Africa believed to be growing.
paragraphs.zh: 这片特别保护区内的狮子种群数量现有800?1200只，属于非洲为数不多仍在增长的狮群之一。

paragraphs.en: In South Africa, which has embraced the trophy hunters strongest and longest, game populations have risen from 500,000 in 1964 to more than 20 million; more than two-thirds of these animals can be found on private reserves.
paragraphs.zh: 南非对战利品狩猎接纳程度最高、时间也最长，当地野生动物数量已经从1964年的50万只增长至2000万只以上；其中超过三分之二的野生动物都栖息在私人保护区内。

paragraphs.en: Conversely, Kenya, which banned hunting in 1977, has seen some of the steepest declines in all Africa.
paragraphs.zh: 与之相反，肯尼亚自1977年起全面禁止狩猎，其野生动物数量下滑幅度位居非洲前列。

paragraphs.en: If banning trophy hunting would lead to the loss of wilderness areas and a collapse in animal populations, would it still be the right thing to do?
paragraphs.zh: 如果取缔战利品狩猎，最终会造成荒野土地流失、野生动物种群崩溃，那么这项禁令还称得上是正确的选择吗？

paragraphs.en: Could one reject an apparently successful strategy out of hand, based solely on sentiment?
paragraphs.zh: 人们是否可以仅仅出于情感因素，就断然否定一项看上去成效显著的保护策略？
